title: Warm the bottle, don't cook it
story: A small heating pad for a sensor box runs from a 12 V battery. It is just one resistor glued to a metal plate. It must give off at least 1 W to keep the box warm in winter, but more than 2 W would cook the glue. Pick the heating resistor.

goals.label: heater gives off at least 1 W

hints: The whole 12 V of the battery sits across the resistor.
Use P = V^2 / R: a smaller resistor gives MORE power at a fixed voltage.
Work backwards: for 1 W you need R = 144 / 1 = 144 ohm or less; for 2 W, R = 144 / 2 = 72 ohm or more.
